notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
performance optimization
 fixed bug - some potions did not affect perk “Drunk master”
 fixed bug - cannonbot rocked while movement and after death
 fixed bug - sometimes fire rain used twice if you played with friends
 fixed bug - mobs could not reach the player if you climbed the table
 fixed bug - when filling bottles with healing runes, a hint was shown that the bottle is full, even if there are unfilled bottles
 fixed bug - sometimes the player did not get up after the resurrection
 fixed popup menu size in settings
 fixed turning off the glow of Crystal  Keeper
 fixed bug - merchant sold starting spells of heroes
 if Cryomancer and Pyromancer perk are encountered, both spells are added to the spellbook (previously only one of them was added)
 now you can try to crack the chest with the “Peterman” perk, even if someone tried to open it before you
 fixed tooltip when cracking a chest
 fixed bud - shooters attacked dead targets
 fixed animation of spells  cooldown on slots
 fixed bug - sometimes after an arcane copy explosion, enemies did not stop attacking it
 fixed bug - sometimes rocket from MG300P boss didn't shoot down
 fixed bug - mine-hunter sometimes turned off running animation
 fixed bug - sometimes beholders didn't go out of invisibility

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes: Made performance optimizations

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Fixed bug - it was possible to resurrect a living player
 Fixed bug - sometimes target didn't take damage from the ricochet
 Fixed bug - sometimes progress was not saved
 Fixed bug - feared by Ananshi players ran on the spot
 Fixed player animation after transfiguration
 Fixed mummy animation when feared
 Performance optimizations

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Fixed bug - sometimes enemies was stucked in pets and wasn't able to pass
 Fixed bug - sometimes settings were reset to default
 Fixed bug - after using Petrification spell player was able to stay frozen forever

notes.title: Daily Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed bug - sometimes a golem boss projectile did random damage.
 Now if a character accidentally falls under the floor, he will move back to the point where he was before falling.

notes.title: Daily Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We are a bit late with the daily update. We wanted to finish the bug fix with friends online state.

So fixes:

 Fixed a bug with friends online
 Reduced number of network objects at the level - this should help with connection lost
 Fixed resurrection of players under portals
 Ultimate abilities added to spellbook

notes.title: Daily Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Connection stability has been improved.
 Fixed a bug - the cursor disappeared and did not appear after the appearance of the boss
 Fixed a bug "Tooltips for spells not disappearing"
 Hotfix "No Players Online". Now you can invite offline players to the group.
 Increased button to invite friends in the group
 Added an additional button to invite friends in the group in the game menu
 Now only one frozen chest appears on the level.
 Fixed localization.

notes.title: Patch 13.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/04eccf8ccd526b4f4f24a02420d2b569e9c82c4e.png


 fixed the heart of the mountain - it works once and can't deal critical damage
  Fixed perk fortune - added gold for summoned enemies 
  Fixed a bug of the mechanical golem - no longer pushes players
  Fixed ring of lightness - no longer changes the spell flying distance
  The tooltip for the gamepad on the character selection window is fixed - it does not disappear when you enter the group
  the "swamp" ability is aiming when you use a gamepad
  item "strange mirror" changed - adds 20% to damage after rebound
  Fixed a bug with the exit from a form of a golem and a lizard, when the player is dead - the model was changed to the model of the player and the player stood on his feet.
  Fixed a bug with the ability "petrification" when the golem or lizard did not have a stone material
  Fixed bug with the effect of perk "time shift" - when in the form of a lizard or golem there was no glow of hands
 The visual effect of the "time shift" buff has been fixed - sometimes it was  removed before the buff was dropped
 Fixed a bug - the map did not remove the line to the portals, if you move to the next level
  Fixed disappearance of the line on the map, when the gamepad selects a portal for teleportation
  Fixed distortion of Crystal Keeper's "Power ray" 
  removed the selection of the slot when using the scroll of  librarian, when the gamepad is not used
  fixed the closing of the spell book - now you can use the same key you opened
  Fixed bug - corpses of enemies flew through walls
  Fixed a permanent witch invisibility bug if using the portal during invisibility
  when applying a golem's potion or a lizard's potion, the player's name changes

notes.title: Patch 12.3
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/5ff9db0d8208e2e4270528459d061554734dd06e.png
- fixed teleporting on players
- fixed bug - ananshi spawned eggs outside a room
- fixed bug - boss door opened when interact object is used
- fixed bug - controller help window was locked on the screen
- fixed bug - controller didn't close map properly
- fixed bug - in some situations fight started without one player
- drunken master is shown as a buff now
controller:
- improved UI
- start/option button to open game menu
- settings can be changed by controller now
- reworked gamepad aiming
- gamepad aiming for "stun ray" and "lightning strike". hold a button to chose a target and then release to fire.
- ps4. one button to apply("x")

notes.title: Patch 12.2
notes.notes:
Controller support.
In this patch, we added controller support. This is the first version, so we are waiting for your feedback.

notes.title: Patch 12.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995846/acdb9b1451149dca34fa95d569508a15f5ee2cb0.png
 New: 
- potions
  - potion of lizardman
  - potion of golem
  - potion of reduction
  - potion of growth
- a new witch model
- main ability tooltip. Added information about applied modifiers
- added a system of players readiness. Now the game will begin only when all players confirm their readiness.
- added the ability to view the current character stats when selecting levelup perks (press "c" key one more time)
- now the characters icons are displayed on the map
- added notification of overflow of inventory 
- added  "continue" button to the menu
- optimized heroes reroll button

 Changes: 
- ice wall. Repeated use destroys the wall
- petrification. Press again to exit the form
- transfiguration. Repeated use (when hit by enemies) can only be applied within 2 sec.
- starting perk rage. Now increases damage by 1% for every 1% of lost health below half
- scroll of librarian. Now you can choose one of three random spells

 Fixes: 
- fixed bug. When firing and hovering on the icons of spells and inventory, shooting ceased
- multilightning. Now deals damage on shields.
- fixed a bug when the nature gift buff was not displayed.
- corrected the sound of the golem's strike
- fixed bug. In some situations, red danger zones of the boss's golem didn't disappear.
- fixed bug. In some situations, the character stopped shooting
- fixed bug. A lightning strike inflicted damage to the lizard specialist, even if he was invisible
- fixed bug. In some situations, the room didn't finish
